## Setup

**Factorization:** $2015 = 5 \times 13 \times 31$.

**CRT decomposition:** $a$ is a $k$-th power residue mod $n=p_1p_2p_3$ (squarefree) iff it's a $k$-th power residue mod each $p_i$. (Forward: reduction mod $p_i$. Backward: CRT lifts solutions $x_i^k \equiv a \pmod{p_i}$ to a single $x$.)

**Group structure:** For prime $p$, $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$ is cyclic of order $m=p-1$. The $k$-th power residues (nonzero) form the unique subgroup of index $d=\gcd(m,k)$, i.e., order $m/d$. Also $a\equiv 0$ is always a $k$-th power residue ($0^k=0$).

## Per-prime analysis

| | $p=5,\; m=4$ | $p=13,\; m=12$ | $p=31,\; m=30$ |
|---|---|---|---|
| $d$ for $k=2$ | $\gcd(4,2)=2$ | $\gcd(12,2)=2$ | $\gcd(30,2)=2$ |
| $d$ for $k=3$ | $\gcd(4,3)=1$ | $\gcd(12,3)=3$ | $\gcd(30,3)=3$ |
| $d$ for $k=5$ | $\gcd(4,5)=1$ | $\gcd(12,5)=1$ | $\gcd(30,5)=5$ |

**Subset sizes** (nonzero subgroup order $= m/d$, plus 0):

| | mod 5 | mod 13 | mod 31 |
|---|---|---|---|
| $\|Q_p\|$ | $2+1=3$ | $6+1=7$ | $15+1=16$ |
| $\|C_p\|$ | $4+1=5$ | $4+1=5$ | $10+1=11$ |
| $\|F_p\|$ | $4+1=5$ | $12+1=13$ | $6+1=7$ |

**Intersection sizes:** In a cyclic group, the intersection of subgroups of indices $d_1, d_2$ is the subgroup of index $\operatorname{lcm}(d_1,d_2)$. Adding 0 to each:

| | mod 5 | mod 13 | mod 31 |
|---|---|---|---|
| $\|Q_p\cap C_p\|$ | $m/\text{lcm}(2,1)+1=2+1=3$ | $12/6+1=3$ | $30/6+1=6$ |
| $\|Q_p\cap F_p\|$ | $4/2+1=3$ | $12/2+1=7$ | $30/10+1=4$ |
| $\|C_p\cap F_p\|$ | $4/1+1=5$ | $12/3+1=5$ | $30/15+1=3$ |
| $\|Q_p\cap C_p\cap F_p\|$ | $4/2+1=3$ | $12/6+1=3$ | $30/30+1=2$ |

## Global counts (via CRT: $|S| = |S_5|\cdot|S_{13}|\cdot|S_{31}|$)

$$|Q|=3\cdot7\cdot16=336,\quad |C|=5\cdot5\cdot11=275,\quad |F|=5\cdot13\cdot7=455$$

$$|Q\cap C|=3\cdot3\cdot6=54,\quad |Q\cap F|=3\cdot7\cdot4=84,\quad |C\cap F|=5\cdot5\cdot3=75$$

$$|Q\cap C\cap F|=3\cdot3\cdot2=18$$

## Inclusion-exclusion for "exactly one"

The number of elements in exactly one of three sets $A,B,C$ is:
$$|A|+|B|+|C|-2\bigl(|A\cap B|+|A\cap C|+|B\cap C|\bigr)+3|A\cap B\cap C|$$

*Verification:* element in exactly one set → counted $+1$; in exactly two → $+2-2=0$; in all three → $+3-6+3=0$. ✓

**Substituting:**
$$= (336+275+455) - 2(54+84+75) + 3(18)$$
$$= 1066 - 2(213) + 54 = 1066 - 426 + 54 = \boxed{694}$$
